{{Quote|The power grid's out in six cities in the Oridin region. Oridin itself - well, I'm sure you can see the results of your handiwork.|[[Shas Vadde]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
'''Oridin City''' was a major city on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] that was [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] with concussion missiles from the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. [[Darth Caedus]] used a large-scale [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|Mind trick]] on the operators of the Oridin shield generator to deactivate the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], allowing him to bombard Oridin from orbit, much the same way he had with [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], months prior. After the bombardment, electrical power in six nearby cities was lost, and the shattered underground tunnels that could be found all over the planet were ravaged by fire.
